text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan.
How are your preparations for Hanshin going?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yep, all set!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's a relief.
You're leaving tomorrow around noon, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I won't be able
to see you off, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
This is a really important time for you too, Dia-chan, so focus on yourself!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still... you know.
Not to say it's in exchange or anything,
but just one thing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Will you make a promise with me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...A promise?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Hehe, putting it that way
makes it sound like when we were little kids, though.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But it's no longer just a childhood dream.
We can really do it. —With who we are right now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan has been undefeated so far, right?
Her first graded race... even in the Kisaragi Sho she took a solid 1st place, and she's always been the 1st favorite.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She's the top contender for the Classic Triple Crown from here on, too.
If it's Dia-chan... I just know
she can achieve incredible results.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And me too! This year, I'm definitely going to be the main star!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So, Dia-chan.
Make a promise with me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This year's Arima Kinen.
Face me there!!
And so arrived the day of the Osaka Hai—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
It's about time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Are you ready to show them what we're made of, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The perfect answer♪
...Well then, shall we head out?

On our way out to the paddock filled with cheers,
both Satono Crown and I suddenly stop in our tracks.
There is one reason. ...It's because I felt 'pressure.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So... there's only one girl I can think of
who could unleash something like this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Kitasan, good day.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan.
...Yeah, looking forward to today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I saw your press conference the other day.
Declaring you'll achieve the 'Spring Senior Triple Crown' gave me total chills."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, though, it surprised me.
I almost wondered, "Did Kitasan forget about me?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Otherwise, she wouldn't have said something like that, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No. Both Kura-chan and Duramente-san!
...I said that fully aware of them both.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I said it fully intending to beat every last one of you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I figured as much.
Saying I was surprised would be a lie.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's just the kind of girl you are.
The kind of girl you've—"become."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't back down.
I've "evolved" just the same.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The opening stage of the Spring Senior Triple Crown...
This race is... mine for the taking.
